violations.text: The non-food contact surfaces of the (walk in cooler beverage shelves ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

The floors and walls throughout the walk in cooler and 3 bay sink area have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (beverages) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer and knives) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
Chicken was observed in refrigerator exceeding the 7 day datemarking. PIC voluntarily disposed of food product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Working containers of (liquid ingredients) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
Beverages was observed being stored in the bathroom. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

(Walk in cooler ) located in the (retail ) area was not in good repair. Ambient temperatures observed at 46DF.During inspection, one side of the walk was observed at 39DF.PIC informed to move TCS products to the colder side of unit. Per PIC, technician serviced unit on 7/1/26 and is expected to return on 7/2/26. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine ) sanitizing solution for the (3 bay sink ). New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (slicer table bottom shelf ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2025

(Cold salads ) packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address.PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2025

The cutting boards on top of the prep unit are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2025

The following non-food contact surfaces of the have an accumulation of debris: 1.retail food storage shelves 2.walk in cooler beverage shelves 3.exterior of the prep unit and deli display unit 4.hot chocolate dispenser/machine New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2025
The (ceilings ) in the (retail ) area is in poor repair.Observed water stains. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (throughout the establishment) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2025
